department: Vilcek Institute of Graduate Biomedical Sciences (PhD in Biomedical Sciences, open program)

deadline.value: The admissions timeline gives an application deadline of 1 December 2026 at 5 p.m. ET, followed by 2027 interviews, so it is the cycle for Fall 2027 entry.
deadline.quote: application deadline: December 1, 2026, at 5 p.m. ET | virtual interviews: January 7–13, 2027

gre_subject.value: GRE and GRE subject scores are not required and are not accepted.
gre_subject.quote: We do not require, and will not accept, the GRE or GRE subject test scores.

supervisor.value: The admissions committee selects applicants to interview on research experience; students do three lab rotations in year one.
supervisor.quote: When selecting candidates to interview for the PhD program, the admissions committee values research experience

funding.value: The admissions page gives no funding rule.

entry_route.value: Applicants need at least a bachelor's degree or equivalent, with no minimum GPA.
entry_route.quote: To apply, you must have at least a bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from a college or university of recognized standing

app_fee.value: The Vilcek application fee is $125, and each NYU school application carries its own fee.

fee_waiver.value: Applicants can request a fee waiver in the PhD application portal; the page gives no criteria.
fee_waiver.quote: Applicants can request fee waivers directly within the PhD application portal.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required and are not accepted.
gre_general.quote: We do not require, and will not accept, the GRE or GRE subject test scores.

toefl_min.value: The program no longer requires English proof, so no TOEFL or IELTS score is needed.
toefl_min.quote: We no longer require proof of English proficiency. | There is no need to submit TOEFL or IELTS test scores.

ielts_min.value: The program no longer requires English proof, so no IELTS score is needed.
ielts_min.quote: We no longer require proof of English proficiency. | There is no need to submit TOEFL or IELTS test scores.

english_waiver.value: No English test of any kind is needed, so an applicant with an English-medium Indian degree submits none.
english_waiver.quote: We no longer require proof of English proficiency.

notes: The page says both 'Our application is now open' and 'our application system, which is now closed'; the deadline is taken from the timeline. The 2026 deadline is tied to 2027 interviews on the same timeline block, so it is treated as the Fall 2027 cycle.
